film_facts.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
film_facts.critics_consensus: A prequel that benefits greatly from spotlighting some of The Hunger Games' most beloved characters, Sunrise on the Reaping retreads familiar territory but sturdily enough for the odds to remain in this franchise's favor.
film_facts.critics_overview: They’ll appreciate this movie for not lying to them." In a negative review, Brandon Yu of The New York Times wrote, "[It] manages to be both bloated and limited. There is a cloistered feeling to its vision of both the games and the wider dystopian world.
